SIGNALS.name: Claude
SIGNALS.summary: Claude Docs, Slides and Design leave beta and become available on every plan including Free, with shared editing between a team and Claude.

SIGNALS.name: Claude
SIGNALS.summary: Anthropic puts Claude Dashboards and Claude Motion in beta, turning connected data into live dashboards and ideas into animated explainers.

SIGNALS.name: OpenAI Developers
SIGNALS.summary: OpenAI rolls out Ultrafast for GPT-6.1 Sol in the API, Codex and ChatGPT Work, offering near-Astra intelligence at up to 8x the speed of Sol Standard.

SIGNALS.name: DoT India
SIGNALS.summary: India's Department of Telecommunications says ITU's AI for Good initiative will be inaugurated in New Delhi on 9 October as part of IMC 2026.

SIGNALS.name: OpenAI
SIGNALS.summary: OpenAI says GPT-6 and Intelligent UI are rolling out in ChatGPT for everyone, giving more visual, interactive answers and on-the-spot tools for tasks.

SIGNALS.name: Claude
SIGNALS.summary: Anthropic introduces Claude Haiku 5.5, its cheapest and fastest small model, which it says costs about 75% less to run than Haiku 4.5.

SIGNALS.name: Liquid AI
SIGNALS.summary: Liquid AI releases Open d1, two open-weight multimodal models: d1-3B (text and vision) and d1-omni-600M (text with image or audio), for real-time decisions from data centers to edge devices.

SIGNALS.name: Mistral AI
SIGNALS.summary: Mistral previews Mistral Large 4, a natively multimodal model with 1T parameters (49B active), which it calls the best open-weights model from the US or Europe on aggregated benchmarks.
